title.justification: This is the title of the paper.

extractions.description: The paper introduces Task-Informed Meta-Learning (TIML), an augmentation to model-agnostic meta-learning which takes advantage of task-specific metadata to improve performance in crop type classification and yield estimation, especially in data-sparse regions.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly mentions the importance of agriculture in mitigating and adapting to climate change, assessing food security, and increasing productive land without sacrificing carbon sinks.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: A complete picture of global agricultural practices is vital to mitigate and adapt to the effects of climate change, including by assessing food security in the event of extreme weather, more rapidly responding to food crises, and increasing pro- ductive land without sacrificing carbon sinks.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on improving agricultural practices, specifically crop type classification and yield estimation, which are crucial for mitigating climate change impacts in agriculture.
primary_category.quote: A complete picture of global agricultural practices is vital to mitigate and adapt to the effects of climate change

secondary_categories.justification: The paper also addresses adapting to climate change by improving food security and responding to food crises.
